safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes return if not improving but does not state to seek review earlier if feeling more unwell.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting explicit safety-net advice to seek earlier review if becoming more unwell can delay recognition and treatment of dehydration or evolving serious infection in a patient with acute gastroenteritis symptoms. While the note still includes a follow-up timeframe if not improving, the lack of “worsening sooner” guidance modestly increases risk of delayed escalation.
